changelog:
## What's new in v0.10.0

### Companion (LAN)
- Bind the daemon (`AKASHA_BIND`, `/api/companion/*`) so an ESP32 Companion can discover, pair, and use voice on your network.

### First-use embedded
- Setup wizard: GGUF download with progress, multi-model picker, calibration, first message test.
- **`akasha-full-windows-x86_64-cuda.zip`** (CLI CUDA + UI + scripts); `doctor --json` suggests `embedded-download` when needed.

### Local inference & integrations
- Compact prompts and 8k context for mid-size Ollama.
- Service discovery (`akasha discover`, `GET /api/discovery`) for Ollama and Home Assistant; HA connector, plugin, and `ha_*` tools.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/azerothl/Akasha/compare/v0.9.0...v0.10.0
